decisions.reason: It extends a very familiar candle-arch form with added sound, so the firm can build on its craft knowledge while absorbing only a moderate amount of new electronic know-how.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid is highly consistent with the firm's longstanding woodworking and seasonal-decoration capabilities, making it easy to refine and retain.
Although the electronic music box is farther from the firm's traditional knowledge base, management has signaled it as a flagship direction and can learn from the related platform variants around it.

This motif platform is a narrower, more experimental complement to the electronic music-box concept and is less central to the firm's core seasonal craft range, so it is the likeliest candidate to be rationalised.
As a Christmas-themed extension of the music-box line, it fits the firm's strongest seasonal market and benefits from learning already accumulated on the electronic platform.
A Christmas pyramid with a regional Dresden theme is closely tied to the firm's established design language, craftsmanship, and customer demand for collectible traditional pieces.
